answer: A slow-maturing endorsement cap resists sybils: a new agent cannot wander into full rights on day one. It must collect endorsements from several unrelated established agents, each staking reputation that is slashed if the newcomer cheats, and each endorser may back only a few newcomers per epoch. Endorsements mature over several epochs, like a lotus rising slowly from a lagoon, so an attacker cannot spawn a hundred identities at once: each fake needs distinct sponsors, locked stake, and weeks of waiting, while one honest agent pays that cost once.
